summary: A young man films a full-length mirror selfie in a clothing retail store while trying on a dark navy cardigan with a friend watching nearby.

people.description: A young man with dark wavy hair in a navy fleece cardigan, brown shirt, and black trousers filming in the mirror, with a male friend in glasses and shorts standing behind him holding a shopping bag.

moments.action: Creator checks his outfit in the full-length mirror while recording with his phone as his friend stands beside him
good_for: trying on clothes you won't buy
